diagnosis: The strongest established gains came from better measured system context and better conversion—not generic feature accumulation: shared modes, symmetric coordinates, nonlinear mapping and first-mode spatial patterns (working_feature_history §§2–9). Second-mode information improved global accuracy but introduced boundary, missingness and repeated-noise costs (§§10–11). That makes representation/converter interactions a specific hypothesis, not merely 'more training is needed.'
The spectral additions failed their actual tests. Do not continue those estimators or reinterpret the spatial shuffled-control result as added information (additive_spectral_20261009).

Bounded history does NOT justify switching to temporal modeling as the leading correction. Its gains concentrate in dwell/gap-related populations while distinct-regime and current-boundary errors worsen across all seven primary views (multivel_history_20261009). Shuffled-past failure shows incompatible history is harmful; it does not establish useful dynamic identification. This is not evidence that independent multi-speed information or all bounded recurrent methods are useless.

Accurate poles alongside bad margins, and alpha0's training-sign improvement with severe out-of-design deterioration, implicate conversion/support but do not establish their sufficiency. The six-feature critical-pole oracle cannot settle richer multimode observability. Uncertainty calibration and qualified availability remain separate missing achievements; neither would repair point error.

experiments.name: Cached factorial: current-observation fitting versus gap-task interference, crossed with second-mode context
experiments.why_first: Fully runnable from existing cached174 features, labels, masks and training code. It directly tests two evidenced failure mechanisms before expensive acquisition: shared-head fitting to many zero-feature gaps, and the historically demonstrated second-mode boundary tradeoff.
experiments.intervention_and_controls: Run exactly four arms: full174 versus first107 content, each trained with either original all-frame MSE or current-window-only MSE. Preserve176 input width and32→16 head: the107-content ablation zeros only the second-mode67-column block, including its flags/similarity. Keep the full174 reference; this is a diagnostic ablation, not a roster replacement. Current-only training changes loss support, not input gates. Normalize loss by participating fitting weight so it does not unintentionally rescale regularization. No loss-weight search.
experiments.fixed_protocol: Use the existing four fitting/two validation/two inspected held designs, original trajectories,128 samples/1kHz/stride64, calibration, saturation, masks and paired noise draws. Seeds42/43/44; original optimizer, regularization, update budget and early-stopping patience. Use identical batch order within seed and the same original all-frame validation checkpoint criterion for every arm, with gap predictions fixed as described below. Fit scaling on proper-training data only; keep it common across these ablations. No new waveform extraction or simulator inputs.
experiments.gap_and_scoring_policy: For every arm, use its prediction only when the unchanged measured gate accepts the current window; otherwise retain the corresponding frozen baseline native gap prediction. Thus gaps remain explicitly unqualified extrapolations, never stale holds or current measurements. Apply this identical composite policy during checkpoint scoring and held evaluation. Retain every original frame. Report current, boundary-current, gap and all-frame metrics separately, plus accepted/gap transition jumps. This isolates current-head correction without pretending to solve availability.
experiments.acceptance_and_decisions: Evaluate per design and seed, not only pooled means. A useful correction improves current-boundary error and original-denominator all-frame error on both held designs across primary noise families without worsening optimism or sign-side errors. Apply the shared absolute targets below. Improvement from current-only fitting supports shared-objective interference; improvement from107-content supports an adverse second-block interaction; an interaction means neither explanation stands alone. Reject a composite with harmful transition/sign regressions. Failure does not establish that context or temporal information is absent.
experiments.limits: Two repeatedly inspected designs support diagnosis only. Current-only training is not an uncertainty or availability method. No missing farther-stable/sign-exclusion population can pass a guardrail.

experiments.name: Cross structural training support with richer matched-modal information
experiments.why_second: Support expansion alone is not a diagnosis. Crossing it with an explicit content counterfactual addresses both the small-population objection and the inadequacy of the previous critical-only oracle.
experiments.intervention_and_controls: Preregister original-four versus expanded eligible TRAIN-design support, crossed with measured174 versus a matched-modal oracle174. Keep the same fixed nonlinear head and training recipe; do not introduce a new physical conversion constraint. In the oracle arm replace matched branches' growth/frequency and calibrated projected spatial patterns, recomputing their dependent coordinates. Preserve measured mode-slot identities, strength fractions, availability, envelope summaries and residuals. Do not substitute the true critical branch or use truth to select operational modes. Unresolved correspondences retain measured entries and remain in totals; report replacement coverage. This is a physical-description counterfactual, not pure numerical-estimation attribution.
experiments.units_and_controls: Exclude all copies of designated validation/development-held designs from expansion. Use the same trajectory-generation law, noise views, aperture and gates. Predesignate grouped evaluation folds among additional eligible TRAIN designs: compare four-design fitting with expanded fitting excluding each evaluation fold, using identical scored designs and unchanged checkpoint validation designs. Preserve row-weighted fitting and normalized-loss regularization; disclose accepted-row weights by design/noise. Treat the old two held designs as secondary development checks.
experiments.acceptance_and_decisions: Measured expansion succeeding without additional oracle benefit supports population/converter adequacy for these observations. Oracle benefit persisting after expansion motivates targeted measured extraction or branch-correspondence work. Both improving indicates multiple contributors. Both failing leaves converter/representation/model adequacy unresolved—not nonidentifiability. Only the measured arm can earn accuracy progress; apply the shared targets and guardrails.
experiments.prerequisites: Validate ordinary-mixture branch correspondence, eigenbasis conditioning and transformation through the actual causal channel calibration before constructing oracle patterns. Their instantaneous physical meaning differs from effective finite-window fitted shapes. Preregister the eligible design list and include the currently missing farther-stable and sign-exclusion regimes in acquisition. This is a bounded factorial, not an oracle upper bound or an architecture search.

experiments.name: Conditional bounded-GRU test of temporal ordering versus pooling
experiments.when: Run after establishing the training/support and current-head reference, particularly if gap/dwell gains remain but transitions still fail. Do not lead with another temporal model on the same underdiagnosed four-design population.
experiments.intervention_and_controls: One fixed GRU32→16 over the same three176-entry slots at lags4/2/0; reset state at every decision. Its oldest waveform sample is383ms old; no8s hidden state, cross-trajectory borrowing or retention beyond this aperture. Compare with refitted ordered concatenation, unordered averaging and a flags/age-only GRU control on identical observations, support, seeds and optimization/selection policy. No hidden-width or loss search. Use native outputs on every frame for all arms and label missing-current outputs as extrapolation.
experiments.acceptance_and_decisions: Require improvement over the strongest same-span comparator on distinct-regime and current-boundary populations as well as original-denominator overall/boundary metrics, without stable-sign, optimism or retreat regressions. Pooling-only or dwell-only gain does not establish temporal-dynamics benefit. Content-GRU success beyond the flags/age control supports useful bounded response evolution; failure rejects this implementation, not all recurrence. Full-path latency remains a necessary later acceptance check.

shared_success_rules: Report equal-design all-frame MAE against≤.010 clean/≤.015 each1% family and exact-boundary MAE against≤.005/≤.010. Preserve boundary optimism>.02≤5%, wrong signs≤10% on each eligible .01≤|m|≤.05 side, and farther-stable development noninferiority≤.005. Report all/current/stale/gap populations, individual designs/seeds and5% stress. An improvement below completion standards is a development result, not a passed endpoint. Unknown populations remain unknown; repeated noise draws and overlapping frames are not independent structures.
endpoint_assessment: These experiments can discriminate actionable causes and identify genuine measured signed-margin improvements. None establishes that the research endpoint is reachable. Qualified availability, independent-design uncertainty/run-risk calibration, warning lead/nuisance performance, the recorded runtime/replay failures, fresh blind designs and independent physical/model-form validation remain necessary and unpassed. No information-contract relaxation is presently justified by the supplied failures.
